headline: US, Russia and Ukraine hold trilateral talks aimed at ending war – Europe live

members.title: US officials seek ‘final end’ to Russia-Ukraine war as Abu Dhabi talks begin
members.lead: First substantive peace talks since February to include US proposal for ‘long-term security architecture’ between Moscow and Europe US officials said they would seek a “final end” to the war between Russia and Ukraine, beginning with trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday in the first substantive negotiations between the two countries since February. The talks are also the first since the US launched joint strikes with Israel against Iran, and they follow bruising midterm elections that have weakened Donald Trump at home. Continue reading...

members.title: US, Russia and Ukraine hold trilateral talks aimed at ending war – Europe live
members.lead: US-led talks in Abu Dhabi are first substantive negotiations in months focusing on ending the conflict which has raged for more than four years US officials seek ‘final end’ to Russia-Ukraine war as talks begin The EU has said it stands ready “to come with a swift and united response” after France blamed Iran for a spate of cyber-attacks on supermarket freezers and chillers that caused millions of euros of damage. Speaking to journalists on Monday, French foreign minister Jean-Noël Barrot said “Europe-wide sanctions” would be imposed against those responsible as he announced that France believed that Iran’s Revolutionary Guards were “responsible for this attack”. We acknowledge that France has attributed these (cyber-attacks) to Iran. Pending discussions with member states, we as the European Union, we stand ready to come with a swift and united response. We as the EU, we have consistently called on all states to refrain from malicious behaviour in the cyberspace. And we will continue to address such malicious behavior, making use of all the tools that we have also under the EU cyber diplomacy toolbox, including sanctions. Continue reading...
